summary: Select the newest stored screener snapshot at or before the requested comparison date, falling back to the oldest earlier snapshot only when that baseline is unavailable.
reason: The store keeps up to 500 daily snapshots, so a fixed recent-window read can silently compare a long --since request against a much newer date and misstate the period covered.
validated_outcome: Tests exercise a requested one-year baseline beyond 60 newer snapshots and fallback to the oldest available earlier snapshot.
